native_model.detail: Construct/mutate; both overloads; fixed array and vector methods; exception; one destructor.

secondary_base_cast.detail: Both base-pointer calls return correct values across a nonzero secondary-base offset.

python_multiple_inheritance.detail: Python isinstance recognizes both C++ bases.

default_custom_allocator.detail: Real TRICK_MM_INTERFACE registered storage; Python ownership removed registration and destroyed exactly once.

owned_factory.detail: Real TRICK_MM_INTERFACE registered storage; Python ownership removed registration and destroyed exactly once.

borrowed_aliases.detail: Live aliases share actual MM storage; wrapper GC retains storage; bounds/deletion checked.

resize_invalidation.detail: Real MM resize preserves data; shared epoch rejects old handles; fresh handle sees new size.

name_reuse_invalidation.detail: Allocation identity rejects stale aliases even when the name is reused.

checkpoint_restore.detail: Actual ClassicCheckPointAgent serialized/restored C++ record and array; old handles rejected.

invalid_checkpoint.detail: Invalid checkpoint declaration propagates a Python exception through the adapter.

units.detail: UDUNITS scale, affine offset and incompatible-dimension exception.

live_vector.detail: Opaque/live vector property mutates C++ storage and retains Python-owned parent.

reflection_syntax.detail: Generic attribute syntax is a separate architectural experiment; not added to this adapter.
